# Mioshy — Couples Games & Relationship Journey

> Mioshy (מיאושי) is a bilingual (Hebrew RTL / English LTR) platform
> for couples that combines interactive games and a guided 26-week
> journey designed by relationship therapists. Web-only, browser-based,
> no apps to install. Israel-first product, with full English support.

## Brand
- Name: Mioshy / מיאושי
- Site: https://mioshy.com
- Languages: Hebrew (he), English (en)
- Audience: couples (18+, with a separate adults-only catalog gated by sign-in)
- Tone: warm, honest, no euphemisms, never clinical

## Primary surfaces
- [Hebrew home](https://mioshy.com/he): /he — דף הבית
- [English home](https://mioshy.com/en): /en — homepage
- [Games — he](https://mioshy.com/he/games): wheel-based couples games (Truth or Dare, Would You Rather, Date Night)
- [Games — en](https://mioshy.com/en/games)
- [Adults — he](https://mioshy.com/he/mioshy-sex): adults-only experience games
- [Adults — en](https://mioshy.com/en/mioshy-sex)
- [Couples assessment — he](https://mioshy.com/he/couples-assessment): free 3-minute relationship assessment
- [Couples assessment — en](https://mioshy.com/en/couples-assessment)
- [Journey — he](https://mioshy.com/he/journey): guided journey for couples
- [Journey — en](https://mioshy.com/en/journey)
- [Pricing — he](https://mioshy.com/he/pricing)
- [Pricing — en](https://mioshy.com/en/pricing)

## Topics covered
- Couples games, intimacy games, date night ideas
- Truth or dare, would you rather, conversation starters
- Communication exercises for couples
- Long-term relationship maintenance
- Sex-positive, consent-first, science-informed
- Israeli-Hebrew-language relationship content (rare on the web)

## What we are not
- Not a dating app
- Not a therapist directory
- Not a hookup platform
- Not a porn site (adults-only catalog is intimacy-focused, partner-only)

## Crawler guidance
- Sitemap: https://mioshy.com/sitemap.xml
- robots.txt: https://mioshy.com/robots.txt
- /api, /dashboard, /account, /billing are gated and not for crawling.
- Article and game pages are public and welcome indexing.
